messages:
maya: FYI - I'm seeing a sharp tail-latency spike in hosted eu-west-1 today. Looks tied to kernel scheduler preemption on GPUs serving >7B models. Customers on chat endpoints are reporting 95p latency jumps.

ops-bot: Incident created: INCIDENT-2026-0304-01 — kernel scheduler latency surge. Status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INCIDENT-2026-0304-01 :rotating_light:

raj: Oncall taking. Investigating scheduler logs now. Suspect regression from kernel v2.3.4 -> v2.4.0 mix after last night's rollout.

sofia: Noted. Which pools are affected? Is this only hosted eu-west-1 or also dedicated nodes?

maya: Affected pools: hosted-eu-west1-gpuA (heavy), hosted-eu-west1-gpuB (light). No dedicated reports so far.

emma: Heads-up to support: please prepare short customer-facing blurb. We should mention mitigations and ETA.

raj: Root cause hypothesis: scheduler preemption ordering changed, causing extra context-switches and KV cache thrash on long-context models. Mitigation plan: roll back kernel to v2.3.4 on eu-west1 pools and enable temporary rate-shed for >7B models. Rolling restart in waves.

maya: Rolling rollback started on hosted-eu-west1-gpuA. Wave 1 (10% hosts) -> completed, latency improved ~45% on those hosts.

ops-bot: Wave 1 rollback completed @3054322025. Wave 2 (30%) started.

sofia: Can we add a quick toggle to route >7B requests to gpuB while we finish rollback? That would protect customer requests in-flight.

raj: Yes, beginning traffic steering to less-impacted gpuB pool for longer-context requests. Config: 
```
route: if model_size > 7B and seq_len > 2048 -> pool hosted-eu-west1-gpuB
```
Applied at ingress layer.

emma: Draft for support message: "We are investigating increased latency for longer-context models in eu-west-1. Mitigation in progress: rollback of recent kernel update and traffic steering. No data loss; some requests may experience transient errors. We’ll update in 30m." Approve?

maya: Approve. Post now.

incident-bot: Status page updated: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INCIDENT-2026-0304-01 — Mitigation: rollback + traffic steering.

raj: Current state: wave 2 rollback ~60% complete, tail latency trending down but still above SLO. Continuing wave 3. If rollback finishes and latency normalizes, we'll keep an eye for recurrence before re-rolling forward.

sofia: Any customer impact list yet?

maya: Initial list: 12 customers with >1% error or >2x tail latency; support is notifying top 3 directly. No major payment-impacting customers.

emma: ETA for full mitigation 45-60 minutes at current pace. Will update support and status in 15m.

ops-bot: Postmortem reminder: tag "kernel-rls" and collect kernel CI runs from last 48h.

maya: Thanks team. I’ll continue to own rolling rollback and verify KV cache stability after wave 3. Ping me for anything urgent. :thumbsup:
